review_type: fresh independent bounded design review, no code edits or nested agents

findings.problem: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT is assigned inline to the uv sync command, absent from ci.env, and absent from subsequent uv run --no-sync commands. A shell command-local assignment does not persist to later commands. Those commands can use the default project .venv rather than the separately provisioned llm_eval environment, invalidating isolated dependency-present qualification and typing or failing on unrelated missing packages.

evidence.probe_meaning: Direct installed uv no-sync stdlib-only environment selection proof; no sync, dependency mutation, model loading or qualification was performed.

findings.required_design_correction: Specify one persistent step-level UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT for every provisioning, metadata/resource/preflight, pytest, artifact verifier and optional typing command, or explicitly use the exact isolated interpreter everywhere. Add a sys.executable/sys.prefix receipt checked against that owned environment. Preserve llm_eval syncing extra and lock contract.

findings.location: validation_matrix.LP03 and real missing-resource evidence contract
findings.problem: LP03 proposes real missing NLTK resource checks with isolated NLTK_DATA. NLTK_DATA only prepends search locations and does not remove home, prefix or system fallback paths, so an empty isolated directory can still find both resources. Such a test could miss the actual negative path and falsely claim absence qualification.

evidence.probe: Fresh child creates empty TemporaryDirectory, sets NLTK_DATA to it, imports actual nltk, reports nltk.data.path and actual find results.

findings.required_design_correction: Run missing-resource probes in isolated children with the real nltk.data.path restricted to explicitly prepared test roots before invoking actual profile preflight; prepare the other required resource, assert the deliberately omitted lookup actually raises LookupError, then verify scoped prerequisite failure occurs before Pipeline/Registry import and download. Record exact effective search paths and absence. Keep this isolation in negative-test harness only; no production global monkeypatch is required.
